original_test_intent: Verify fatal uncorrectable ECRC handling across every required PCIe slot at both endpoint and upstream root port, including the approved fatal containment or reset path, attributable records and complete post-boot device/link recovery.
original_method: Resolve whether errortype 2 produces fatal ECRC despite the Correctable step labels; map every physical slot to endpoint/upstream BDF and dependency; decode severity/masks/DPC/SyncFlood policy; capture durable pre-state and OOB console; inject one approved source once; timestamp AER/ECRC reporting, containment or reset and reboot; correlate source ID and exact severity; verify link/device/driver recovery and no persistent error; restore BIOS/HDT/AER state before another target.
manual_activity: The FAE resolves the Correctable-versus-fatal command conflict, maps each slot path, approves fatal AER/DPC/SyncFlood behavior, performs one injection under independent OOB control and owns reset, boot and device recovery.
required_inputs: Authoritative AMD proof that errortype 2 selects ECRC and its fatal severity/source semantics
Physical slot/device serial to endpoint and upstream root-port BDF/dependency map
Decoded 7EF6030 format/value plus AER masks, DPC, Reset After Sync-Flood and SyncFlood policy
Expected endpoint versus root-port AER status/source ID and fatal containment/reset outcome
Reset, firmware, boot, driver/link recovery deadlines and durable BMC/UEFI/OS evidence
Supported OS, tool/spec version/hash/license, aborts, OOB recovery and restoration
safety_requirements: Dedicated backed-up SUT with independent BMC/console and known-good boot/reimage path
Resolve command severity before execution and revalidate the exact target path; never copy BDFs
Quiesce I/O and exclude boot, management and production devices unless explicitly approved
Inject once on one source; abort on wrong source, unexpected severity, boot loop, missing durable evidence or unrecovered link/device
No automatic retry or reset; preserve crash evidence and restore/diff BIOS/HDT/AER/DPC/SyncFlood state
agent_execution_scope: Validate tool semantics, topology, dependency isolation, severity policy and fatal outcome matrix
Collect read-only PCIe/AER, OOB console, reset/boot, OS/BMC, link/device and post-health evidence
Do not resolve contradictory semantics by inference, choose BDF, change BIOS/HDT, inject/reset/retry/recover or decide verdict
engineer_actions: Approve per-slot target and fatal policy/deadlines
Supervise one injection and platform recovery

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Generic log tails cannot prove ECRC source/severity or survive a fatal reset; memory-health wording is unrelated.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Only after vendor resolution, substitute live mapped BDFs, inject one approved errortype-2 source under OOB capture and correlate ECRC/AER source with the exact fatal containment, reset, boot and recovery branch.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The literal BDF pair, errortype 2, Correctable labels, fatal ECRC note, severity/SyncFlood settings, slot 1~N and 30/120-minute values remain preserved as conflicting source facts.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Execute one topology-mapped fatal ECRC stimulus with durable OOB capture and verify the owner-approved containment/reset branch through clean device/link recovery.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds authoritative flag mapping, decoded severity policy, dependency isolation, branch-specific timing, durable evidence and rollback.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Tool PASS plus an OS timeout cannot show fatal ECRC attribution when the OS may reset before logs persist.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A wrong fatal target or policy can reset the host, lose a boot/management device, corrupt active I/O or leave the platform unbootable.

project_override_considerations: If errortype 2 is not proven fatal ECRC for the exact tool release, do not execute or relabel it from analogy. Preserve this test as pending until an approved stimulus replaces or confirms the contradictory step text.

Full injection transcript and exact endpoint/root-port ECRC AER source/status/severity
OOB timestamp of containment/reset, firmware and boot sequence with durable BMC/UEFI record
Recovered OS, driver, link and device with no persistent fatal state

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The title, intent and note require uncorrectable fatal ECRC, but both injection steps are labelled Correctable and the source provides no authority that errortype 2 resolves the mismatch. Slot 1~N uses one BDF pair, 7EF6030 is undecoded, timeout is undefined, RHEL 2022 is ambiguous and DeepSeek carries correctable-memory language.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Static review can identify the fatal ECRC intent and unresolved semantics. Execution is gated pending owner resolution, but the case record itself can be completed.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Reliability row 59 Wistron-System RAS-00779-V002: decide whether the two Correctable step labels are defects and provide vendor proof that errortype=2 selects fatal ECRC at endpoint/root port; supply physical slot/serial-to-BDF coverage for slot 1~N; decode/approve 7EF6030, AER masks, DPC and SyncFlood policy; define exact ECRC source/severity plus fatal containment/reset, durable logging, boot/link/device recovery, supported OS, timeout, aborts, OOB recovery and restoration.

review_improvement: Makes the source's severity contradiction an execution gate and replaces a generic log check with an attributable fatal ECRC, reset/boot and recovery oracle.
independent_technical_reasoning: Fatal PCIe validation cannot rely on a live OS log because the configured response may reset the host before buffers persist. The ECRC source may be reported at the receiver or upstream port, so endpoint/root-port identity and AER source fields are essential. Until errortype 2 and the Correctable labels are reconciled by vendor authority, executing the command could test the wrong severity while appearing to satisfy the title.
